question: Which famous Indian dancer was the founder and director of the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts and received Padma Shri in 1965?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mrinalini Sarabhai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The famous Indian dancer who founded and directed the** Darpana Academy of Performing Arts **and received **Padma Shri in 1965** is **Mrinalini Sarabhai.**
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was a versatile dancer and explored various forms, her focus and expertise were primarily in Bharatanatyam and was known for her **experimental approach** to dance.
 
• Mrinalini Sarabhai was awarded the** Padma Shri**, one of the highest civilian awards in India, in **1965** for her contributions to Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale **was also a** renowned Bharatanatyam dancer** and founder of **Kalakshetra, **a **dance and music **school in Chennai.
 
• **Prabhu Deva **is a contemporary Indian dance choreographer and actor who has won **multiple National Film Awards** for his choreography in Bollywood movies.
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is a **classical Kathak dancer and choreographer **who has also received numerous awards and recognition for his contributions to Indian dance.
